prepared_package.validation: prepare-manuscript validator with local source checks

audit_records: separate passage-map closure and chapter sanity approval
final artifact acceptance bound to exported chapter hashes

checks.expectation: Original DOCX, input snapshot, and prepared source identities remain valid; no source overwrite.
Title and all ten sections are represented exactly once in source order, with no token-limit chapter splitting.
Map item decisions and closure precede drafting; chapter approval is explicit even for an empty sanity diff.
Restart at a human wait preserves the same unresolved gate and settled decisions.
A replayed or stale gate response is rejected without advancing or applying it twice.
Glossary and scoped voice decisions survive chapter/context changes; completed text is not silently rewritten.
Every exported chapter matches its accepted artifact hash and the export manifest.
Fidelity and prose review stay inside translation; no general English-only line-editing stage is inserted.

optional_quality_evaluation.candidate: complete accepted English text assembled in source order
optional_quality_evaluation.role: separate quality assessment; scores do not substitute for workflow assertions
